name: AMB-1
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: A generative ambient machine for the FM-1
description: AMB-1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a generative ambient machine, inspired by Brian Eno's Music for Airports. It plays itself from the moment it's switched on: breathing voices, soft bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass and quiet Euclidean percussion, through a tape echo and a plate reverb. It has eight pieces, and it is an album as much as an instrument. You don't perform it, you tend it: pick a piece and a scale, take notes out, put them back, and let it grow.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
